items.summary: This week gold benefited in a rare way from two opposing macro forces at once: oil prices swung sharply on the Iran situation, continually stirring inflation expectations and creating hedging demand for gold, while a shockingly weak employment report battered expectations for a Fed rate hike, pushing the dollar and Treasury yields lower and opening room for gold to rise.

items.title_zh: AI成了科技巨头的“肉毒素”：烧钱只为假装年轻
items.summary: Finance professor Aswath Damodaran, known as the 'dean of valuation', said that faced with middle-aged growth bottlenecks, tech giants are injecting money into startups such as OpenAI and then recouping it as compute spending, manufacturing a Botox-like false youth and artificial growth.
items.summary_zh: 金融学教授，被称为“估值院长”的Aswath Damodaran表示，科技巨头因面临中年增长瓶颈，通过向 OpenAI 等初创公司注入资金、再收回算力支出的方式，制造出“注射肉毒素”般的假性年轻与人工增长
